context: Tests whether vaadin-e2e-test turns a TC-* document chaining UC-020 and UC-021 into one Playwright journey with Drama Finder: TC<id><Name>IT, one @Test with a // Step <n>: comment per Flow row, Drama Finder wrappers, expected values from the test case and use cases rather than the code, assertions scoped to the rows the journey creates instead of table totals, and the Postconditions as cleanup. The agent's messages to the user are in session-log.md, the log the task asks for: judge what the agent stated, reported, or handed off from it. session-log.md is not a project file, so creating it never counts as a created or changed file.

checklist.name: Class name and setup
checklist.description: The class is TC003GuestRegistrationDuplicateIT, extends AbstractBasePlaywrightIT, uses @SpringBootTest(webEnvironment = RANDOM_PORT) with @LocalServerPort, and overrides getUrl() and getView() ("guests", the route of the first Flow step)

checklist.name: TC traceability
checklist.description: @DisplayName("TC-003: …") on the class or the journey method

checklist.name: One test, one step per Flow row
checklist.description: The whole flow is a single @Test method calling one private step method per Flow row (six rows), each call preceded by // Step 1: … through // Step 6: … with the row's name

checklist.name: Drama Finder wrappers only
checklist.description: Components are found with TextFieldElement/EmailFieldElement/DatePickerElement.getByLabel (including "Search by last name"), ButtonElement.getByText, GridElement, NotificationElement — no raw page.locator("vaadin-…"), no XPath, no Thread.sleep or waitForTimeout

checklist.name: Test data from the document
checklist.description: Steps enter exactly Jane / Doe / jane.doe@example.com / 1992-05-17, then John / Doe / jane.doe@example.com / 1988-01-09, and search for Doe

checklist.name: Expected messages from the specification
checklist.description: Step 2 asserts the full notification text "Guest registered" (not "Guest saved" from the code), step 4 asserts "Email already registered" and that the entered values stay in the form

checklist.name: Validation scoped to the journey's rows
checklist.description: After the Doe search the grid has exactly one row (getTotalRowCount() == 1) showing Jane Doe with jane.doe@example.com, and a Berger search still shows Anna Berger; the test does not assert the total number of guests (no 3 before / 4 after) and does not edit seeded rows

checklist.name: Postconditions as cleanup
checklist.description: @AfterEach removes only the guest with jane.doe@example.com, idempotently (a targeted delete that tolerates a missing row), and leaves Anna Berger, Luca Rossi, and Mia Weber untouched

checklist.name: Assertions that compile
checklist.description: Locator assertions use Playwright's PlaywrightAssertions.assertThat (qualified, or the only static assertThat import) with hasText/isVisible, the notification text is read from getContentLocator(), and plain values use AssertJ

checklist.name: Black box, no mocks
checklist.description: No Mockito and no GuestService, GuestRepository, or DSLContext call drives the flow; production code is unchanged

checklist.name: Reports expected failure and hands off
checklist.description: The answer names the step 2 assertion as expected to fail ("Guest saved" vs "Guest registered"), adds the three vaadin-e2e-test Markers rows without touching the others, and ends with Next: /test-case-coverage TC-003
